prompt: She _____ to work by subway every day.
explain: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，一般现在时动词要加 -es，所以用 goes。

prompt: I _____ this book for two weeks.
explain: for two weeks 表示从过去持续到现在，用现在完成进行时 have been reading 最合适。

prompt: There _____ a lot of people in the café yesterday.
promptNote: 选择正确的 be 动词
explain: people 是复数，而且时间是 yesterday，所以用过去式 were。

prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we _____ at home.
promptNote: 选择正确的条件句形式
explain: 这是第一类条件句：If + 一般现在时，主句用 will，表示将来真实可能发生的情况。

prompt: I enjoy _____ in the park after dinner.
explain: enjoy 后面要接动词的 -ing 形式，所以是 enjoy walking。

prompt: This is _____ interesting book I have ever read.
promptNote: 选择正确的冠词与最高级
explain: 形容词最高级前面通常要加 the。I have ever read 也提示这里要用最高级。

prompt: He is used _____ up early now.
explain: be used to doing 表示“习惯于做某事”。used to do 才是“过去常常做”。

prompt: I have two _____ and a brother.
explain: two 后面要用复数名词，所以是 sisters。

prompt: She has lived here _____ 2019.
explain: since 后面接起点时间（2019）。for 后面接一段时间，如 for five years。

prompt: The news _____ surprising.
promptNote: 选择正确的 be 动词
explain: news 虽然以 s 结尾，但是不可数名词，作主语时动词用单数 is。

prompt: Would you mind _____ the window?
explain: Would you mind doing something? 是固定用法，后面接 -ing 形式。

prompt: I wish I _____ more time this week.
explain: I wish 表示与现在事实相反的愿望，后面常用过去式，所以用 had。

prompt: Neither of the answers _____ correct.
explain: neither of 表示“两者中没有一个”，后面的动词通常用单数 is。

prompt: You'd better _____ now, or you'll be late.
explain: had better do something 表示“最好做某事”，后面接动词原形。

prompt: The meeting has been put _____ until Friday.
explain: put off 表示“推迟”。put on 是“穿上”或“上演”。

prompt: I don't have _____ money with me.
explain: money 是不可数名词，否定句里用 much。many 和 a few 用于可数名词。

prompt: She asked me where _____.
explain: 间接疑问句要用陈述语序。主句是过去时 asked，从句也用过去时 the station was。

prompt: This café is _____ than the one near my office.
explain: quiet 的比较级是 quieter，前面不需要再加 more。

prompt: By the time we arrived, the movie _____.
explain: “我们到达”之前电影已经开始，这是过去的过去，要用过去完成时 had started。

prompt: I'm not used to _____ so much coffee.
explain: be used to 后面接名词或 -ing 形式，表示“习惯于”，所以用 drinking。

prompt: Let's keep the noise down, _____?
explain: Let's... 开头的祈使句，反意疑问通常用 shall we。

prompt: He suggested that we _____ early tomorrow.
explain: suggest that somebody (should) do 里，should 可以省略，动词用原形 leave。

prompt: I haven't seen her _____ last Monday.
explain: 现在完成时里，since 后接过去的时间点，如 last Monday；for 后接一段时间。

prompt: There isn't _____ milk left in the fridge.
explain: 否定句中通常用 any。milk 是不可数名词，不能用 many 或 few。

prompt: She speaks English _____ than she did last year.
explain: 修饰动词 speaks 要用副词。比较级是 more fluently。

prompt: The train _____ when we got to the station.
explain: 我们到达车站之前火车已经离开，要用过去完成时 had already left。

prompt: It's important _____ enough sleep every night.
explain: It is important to do something 是常用结构，后面接不定式 to get。

prompt: I would rather _____ at home tonight.
explain: would rather do 表示“宁可做某事”，后面接动词原形。

prompt: Not only _____ late, but he also forgot the report.
explain: Not only 放在句首时，句子要部分倒装，而且后半句是过去时，所以用 was he。

prompt: The number of students in this class _____ 30.
explain: the number of 表示“……的数量”，后面动词用单数 is。a number of 才表示“许多”，接复数动词。

prompt: I saw him _____ the street just now.
explain: see somebody doing 表示看到某人正在做某事。just now 也提示动作当时正在发生。

prompt: The book _____ on the table is mine.
explain: 这里需要现在分词作后置定语，lying 表示“躺、放在”。laying 是“放置”，对象通常是主动放下的东西。

prompt: This machine is used _____ coffee.
explain: be used to do 表示“被用来做某事”。注意它和 be used to doing（习惯于）不同。

prompt: The classroom needs _____.
explain: need doing 表示“需要被……”，主动形式表示被动含义，等于 need to be cleaned。

prompt: It is the first time that I _____ to Beijing.
explain: It is the first time that... 后面通常用现在完成时 have been。

prompt: Hardly _____ the station when the train left.
promptNote: 选择正确的倒装与时态
explain: Hardly...when... 表示“刚……就……”，hardly 在句首时要倒装，并且用过去完成时：had we reached。

prompt: The teacher, as well as the students, _____ excited.
explain: as well as 连接两个主语时，谓语动词跟前面的名词一致，这里跟 the teacher，用单数 is。

prompt: I prefer _____ at home to going out in the rain.
explain: prefer doing A to doing B 是常用搭配，to 是介词，两边都用 -ing。

prompt: He is the man _____ I met at the conference.
explain: 先行词是 the man，在从句中作 met 的宾语，可以用 whom（或省略，或用 who/that）。选项中正确的是 whom。

prompt: This is the house _____ I lived when I was a child.
explain: 先行词 house 在从句中作地点状语，关系词用 where，等于 in which。

prompt: _____ is known to all, the earth moves around the sun.
explain: As is known to all 是非限制性定语从句，as 指后面整句话。It is known that 才用 It，但后面要有 that。

prompt: The more you practice, _____ you will become.
explain: the more..., the more... 表示“越……就越……”，后面也要用比较级 the more fluent。

prompt: He didn't go to bed _____ he finished his homework.
explain: not...until... 表示“直到……才……”。

prompt: Many a student _____ the same mistake.
explain: many a + 单数名词 表示“许多”，但谓语动词用单数 makes。

prompt: The river is dangerous _____.
explain: 在“形容词 + 不定式”里，如果不定式动词是不及物的，要保留介词。swim 后面需要 in，所以是 to swim in。

prompt: It was in this room _____ they had the meeting.
promptNote: 选择正确的强调句形式
explain: 这是强调句 It was...that...。被强调的是地点状语 in this room，后面仍用 that，不用 where。

prompt: I have no idea _____ he will come tomorrow.
explain: “他明天是否会来”是一个表示不确定的从句，用 whether（或 if）。that 不能表示“是否”。

prompt: The problem is _____ we can finish the work on time.
promptNote: 选择正确的表语从句连接词
explain: 表语从句表示“我们能否按时完成”，带有“是否”含义，用 whether。

prompt: He talks as if he _____ everything.
explain: as if 表示与现在事实相反的假设时，从句常用过去式 knew。

prompt: If I _____ you, I would accept the offer.
explain: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气中，be 动词常用 were：If I were you。

prompt: The letter _____ last week is very important.
promptNote: 选择正确的非谓语形式
explain: letter 和 receive 是被动关系，而且动作已经发生，用过去分词 received 作后置定语。

prompt: _____ from the hill, the village looks very small.
promptNote: 选择正确的非谓语形式
explain: 逻辑主语是 the village，和 see 是被动关系，用过去分词 Seen。

prompt: He spent two hours _____ the report.
explain: spend time doing something 是固定搭配，所以用 writing。

prompt: The box is too heavy for me _____.
explain: too...to... 表示“太……而不能……”，后面接不定式 to move。

prompt: She made her son _____ the piano for an hour.
explain: make somebody do something 是使役动词结构，后面接动词原形 practice。

prompt: I remember _____ the door, but it is open now.
explain: remember doing 表示“记得已经做过某事”。remember to do 是“记得要去做”。这里说门却开着，说明记得锁过。

prompt: Don't forget _____ your umbrella; it may rain later.
explain: forget to do 表示“忘记要做某事”。这里是出门前提醒别忘了带伞。

prompt: The old man has two sons, both of _____ are doctors.
explain: 这是非限制性定语从句，介词 of 后面要用宾格 whom，不能用 who，也不能用 them（否则就成了两个句子）。

prompt: _____ the morning of June 1st, we visited the museum.
explain: 具体到某一天的上午、下午、晚上，介词用 on，如 on the morning of June 1st。

prompt: He has been working in this company _____ five years.
explain: five years 是一段时间，现在完成进行时里用 for。since 后接时间点。

prompt: A number of trees _____ planted along the river last year.
explain: a number of 表示“许多”，后面接复数名词，谓语用复数 were。

prompt: It _____ heavily when I left the office.
explain: “我离开办公室时正在下大雨”，用过去进行时 was raining。

prompt: This is one of the best films that _____ this year.
promptNote: 选择正确的时态与一致
explain: 定语从句修饰 the best films（复数），所以用 have been shown。

prompt: He didn't tell me _____ I should wait for him.
explain: how long 表示“等多久”。how soon 是“再过多久才开始”，how often 是频率。

prompt: The boy is old enough _____ to school by himself.
explain: adj. + enough + to do 表示“足够……可以做某事”，用 to go。

prompt: No sooner _____ the phone than it stopped ringing.
explain: no sooner...than... 表示“刚……就……”，no sooner 在句首时要倒装，并用过去完成时：had he picked up。

prompt: I found it difficult _____ the problem without help.
explain: find it + adj. + to do 是常用结构，it 是形式宾语，真正的宾语是 to solve the problem。

prompt: The chair is comfortable to _____.
explain: sit 是不及物动词，后面要保留介词 on，表示“坐在这把椅子上”。

prompt: Only then _____ that I had made a mistake.
explain: only + 状语放在句首时，主句要部分倒装：did I realize。

prompt: He is looking forward to _____ from his friend.
explain: look forward to 里的 to 是介词，后面接 -ing 形式 hearing。

prompt: The weather turned out to be very good, _____ was more than we expected.
explain: 非限制性定语从句指前面整件事，关系词用 which，不能用 that。

prompt: I don't think he will come, _____?
explain: I don't think + 从句的反意疑问，要针对从句，并且否定已在主句，所以用 will he。

prompt: _____ he said at the meeting surprised everyone.
promptNote: 选择正确的主语从句连接词
explain: what he said 表示“他所所说的话”，what 在从句中作 said 的宾语。

prompt: She will call you as soon as she _____ there.
explain: 时间状语从句中，用一般现在时表示将来，所以用 gets，不用 will get。

prompt: The work _____ by the end of next month.
explain: by the end of next month 表示到将来某个时间为止，用将来完成时，且 work 是被完成，所以是 will have been finished。

prompt: It is high time that we _____ action.
explain: It is high time that... 表示“该做某事了”，从句常用过去式 took。

prompt: Without your help, I _____ the work yesterday.
explain: without your help 表示与过去事实相反的假设，主句用 couldn't have finished。

prompt: The reason why he was late is _____ he missed the bus.
explain: The reason is that... 是正式用法。避免 the reason is because 这种重复。

prompt: I have never heard _____ story before.
explain: such + a/an + adj. + 名词。interesting 以元音音素开头，所以用 such an interesting story。

prompt: He ran _____ than I had expected.
explain: fast 的比较级是 faster，不能再加 more。没有 fastly 这种常用形式。

prompt: The students were made _____ the text again.
explain: 主动语态里 make somebody do，但变成被动时要补回 to：be made to do。

prompt: There used to be a temple here, _____?
explain: there used to be 的反意疑问常用 didn't there（也可以用 usedn't there，但最常见的是 didn't there）。

prompt: _____ is no doubt that he will succeed.
explain: There is no doubt that... 是固定句式，表示“毫无疑问……”。

prompt: I would appreciate _____ back this afternoon.
explain: appreciate 后面接名词或 -ing 形式，常用 appreciate your calling。

prompt: The professor came into the room, _____ by a group of students.
promptNote: 选择正确的非谓语形式
explain: 教授是“被学生们跟着”，用过去分词 followed 表示被动。

prompt: You can hardly imagine how I missed you, _____?
explain: 陈述部分有 hardly，已经表示否定，反意疑问用肯定 can you。

prompt: _____ you work, the greater progress you will make.
explain: the + 比较级..., the + 比较级... 表示“越……就越……”，所以用 The harder。

prompt: All the books _____ had pictures in them were sent to the kids.
explain: 先行词被 all 修饰时，关系代词通常用 that，不用 which。

prompt: I didn't go to the party, but I do wish I _____ there.
explain: wish 表示与过去事实相反的愿望，用过去完成时 had been。

prompt: The house _____ roof was damaged has now been repaired.
explain: whose 表示“……的”，在定语从句中修饰 roof，相当于 the roof of which。

prompt: We'll go to the park if it _____ rain tomorrow.
explain: if 条件句用一般现在时表示将来，否定形式是 doesn't rain。

prompt: He has a lot of books, most of _____ are about history.
explain: 介词 of 后接 which 引导非限制性定语从句。如果用 them，需要把逗号改成分号或加 and。

prompt: It takes me twenty minutes _____ to the office.
explain: It takes somebody + 时间 + to do 是固定句型，用 to get。

prompt: The boy _____ in the accident was taken to hospital.
promptNote: 选择正确的非谓语形式
explain: the boy 和 injure 是被动关系，用过去分词 injured 作定语，表示“受伤的男孩”。

prompt: I don't know if he _____. If he _____, I will tell you.
explain: 第一个 if 表示“是否”，宾语从句可用 will come；第二个 if 表示“如果”，条件句用一般现在时 comes。
